import requests
from datetime import datetime, timezone

# Config
BACKEND_URL = 'https://prospective-worth-carriers-founded.trycloudflare.com'
HEADERS = {'X-N8N-Webhook-Secret': '{{ $env.N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET }}'}

def query_openalex(topic, since_date):
    url = f'https://api.openalex.org/works'
    params = {
        'search': topic,
        'sort': 'publication_date:desc',
        'per_page': 10,
        'filter': f'from_publication_date:{since_date[:10]}'
    }
    try:
        r = requests.get(url, params=params, timeout=30)
        r.raise_for_status()
        data = r.json()
        results = []
        for work in data.get('results', []):
            results.append({
                'title': work.get('title') or '',
                'abstract': ' '.join(work.get('abstract_inverted_index', {}).keys()) if work.get('abstract_inverted_index') else '',
                'url': work.get('doi') or work.get('id', ''),
                'source': 'openalex',
                'published_date': work.get('publication_date', ''),
            })
        return results
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'OpenAlex error: {e}')
        return []

def query_arxiv(topic, since_date):
    import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
    url = 'https://export.arxiv.org/api/query'
    params = {
        'search_query': f'all:{topic}',
        'start': 0,
        'max_results': 10,
        'sortBy': 'submittedDate',
        'sortOrder': 'descending',
    }
    try:
        r = requests.get(url, params=params, timeout=30)
        r.raise_for_status()
        ns = {'atom': 'http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom'}
        root = ET.fromstring(r.text)
        results = []
        for entry in root.findall('.//atom:entry', ns):
            title = entry.find('./atom:title', ns)
            summary = entry.find('./atom:summary', ns)
            link = entry.find('./atom:id', ns)
            published = entry.find('./atom:published', ns)
            results.append({
                'title': (title.text or '').strip().replace('\n', ' ') if title is not None else '',
                'abstract': (summary.text or '').strip().replace('\n', ' ') if summary is not None else '',
                'url': (link.text or '').strip() if link is not None else '',
                'source': 'arxiv',
                'published_date': (published.text or '')[:10] if published is not None else '',
            })
        return results
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'arXiv error: {e}')
        return []

# Fetch active subscriptions
subs_resp = requests.get(
    f'{BACKEND_URL}/api/subscriptions?is_active=true',
    headers=HEADERS,
    timeout=30
)
subs_resp.raise_for_status()
subscriptions = subs_resp.json().get('subscriptions', [])

results = []
for sub in subscriptions:
    since = sub.get('last_checked_at') or '2000-01-01'
    topic = sub.get('topic', '')
    source = sub.get('source', 'openalex+arxiv')

    articles = []
    if source in ('openalex', 'openalex+arxiv'):
        articles.extend(query_openalex(topic, since))
    if source in ('arxiv', 'openalex+arxiv'):
        articles.extend(query_arxiv(topic, since))

    if articles:
        results.append({
            'subscription_id': sub['id'],
            'user_id': sub['user_id'],
            'topic': topic,
            'articles': articles
        })

return results if results else [{'info': 'No new articles found', 'count': 0}]
